thread:
liz chen: Heads up — found CVE-2026-4512 in dependency `node-crypto-helper@2.0.1` used by uploader-service. Public PoC posted: https://tracker.example/CVE-2026-4512 :eyes:
security-bot: Vulnerability ticket created: VULN-421 (priority auto-suggest: HIGH)
max weller: Is this exploitable from the public internet? uploader-service is in private subnets but signed uploads endpoint is public.
liz chen: It's a transitive dep via image-processor. The signed upload flow calls the lib during header parsing. So likely reachable for hosted API and any dedicated customers exposing uploads.
jorge gomez: Upstream released 2.0.2 that claims to fix it. Is the patch backwards-compatible? Any native addon rebuilds?
liz chen: Patch exists. Local build done: unit tests good, some flaky quant tests in infra. There is a native binding rebuild required for linux-musl images. I can push a bump PR but need CI cycles. Estimated: 48h to validate + canary.
sarah ng: We should think SLA impact and customer tiers. If we schedule a rolling restart, will that violate SLA for Dedicated customers? Also Legal will want a short exec summary for disclosure.
max weller: Ops question — can we do an outage-free rolling restart? If so, propose canary Thurs, gradual rollout Mon during low traffic (Sun 02:00 UTC) for the final window.
jorge gomez: Rolling restarts OK but limit concurrency to 10% of pods per AZ. Also prepare a quick rollback if the native binding causes issues. We can add a temporary WAF rule to block the PoC request pattern as mitigation while we patch.
liz chen: I'll open PR with `package.json` bump to 2.0.2 + native rebuild, add smoke test that exercises header parsing. PR: https://git.example/r/uploader/pulls/1287
max weller: Assign severity P1 given public PoC and hosted exposure. CS needs a customer-facing note. @sarah ng can you coordinate CS and Legal?
sarah ng: On it. I'll draft an internal exec summary and a premium-customer advisory. Max, can you draft the initial customer comms?
max weller: Yep, will draft. Ops: any objections to canary tomorrow 10:00 UTC?
deploy-bot: Canary pipeline triggered: uploader-service:bump-nodecrypto-2.0.2 -> build #8421 (queued)
jorge gomez: Watch 5xx rate and latency during canary. If 5xx > 0.5% or p95 latency increases >25%, abort and rollback.
liz chen: Noted. I'll include health checks and rollout policy in the PR. Canary scheduled for tomorrow 10:00 UTC, full rollout target Mon 02:00 UTC. Maintenance notice draft in #general will be ready after PR merges.
max weller: Also offering assisted patch for Enterprise customers who want a concierge window. Add to the CS note.
sarah ng: Added. Closing loop: security triage -> patch PR -> canary -> monitor thresholds -> full rollout. I'll update VULN-421 with timeline and owners. :white_check_mark:
max weller: Thanks — keep updates short in the ticket.
liz chen: Will do.
